title: Silybum marianum cream for medicinal use
intro: Silybum marianum cream is a topical herbal preparation made from the milk thistle plant, known for its liver-supporting properties. It is commonly used in herbalism to promote liver health and detoxification by reducing inflammation and protecting liver cells from damage. The cream may also help alleviate symptoms of skin conditions due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. It is often applied directly to the skin for localized treatment. In traditional medicine, it is valued for its ability to support overall metabolic function and skin health.
